findings.title: code-review-graph-status never runs: binary not on hook-hub PATH
findings.detail: hook-hub skipped code-review-graph-status 1 time in this turn with reason handler_binary_missing. The hub runs with a system PATH (/usr/local/sbin:...:/snap/bin) that has no mise shims and no ~/.local/bin, so concerns.py executable() never finds the handler binary and the handler is dead.

findings.title: enricher session report dead-lettered by Candystore
findings.detail: Candystore rejected bloodbank.report.session.completed 5298c04f-eb7c-4cda-ba0a-e3bce48db03e from enricher on /events/all (malformed: missing CloudEvents fields: producer, service, domain, kind); the summary 'Session completed with 2 tool invocations.' survives only in dead_letter.raw. It is a Dapr envelope (type com.dapr.event.sent), not a 33GOD CloudEvent.

findings.title: ASM never reaches 'gone' for session-keyed scopes
findings.detail: claude:s:b65e93b6-f365-417c-bf83-28e876aaf106 is keyed by the native session id (pid recorded as 0). SessionEnd/Stop only quiesce it; the sweeper cannot prove a sid scope gone, so it just expires 900 s after the last edge.

findings.title: ASM hash carries no session_id / correlationid
findings.detail: HGETALL asm:a:claude:s:b65e93b6-f365-417c-bf83-28e876aaf106 has empty session_id and correlationid; only the scope embeds the session id.

findings.title: no distributed trace id: traceparent is all zeros on every event; the waybill reconstructs causation itself
findings.detail: 18 envelope(s) inspected; none carries a real W3C traceparent (placeholder 00-000…-000…-00 or absent).
